en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of Monaco. The image captures the rocky promontory of Monaco-Ville (the Old Town) jutting into the sea with dense buildings on the cliff, the harbor and coastline stretching into the distance, and hills in the background. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe it as a general view of the principality.
